releaseNotes: v1.0.10: Extreme performance, efficiency, and resource optimization. Eliminated startup app loading delays by parallelizing package loading across CPU cores and switching to an on-demand async LRU icon cache, slashing startup time from 10+ seconds to instant (~100ms) and dropping RAM usage by over 90%. Streamed ART dexopt dumps directly from shell buffers without memory allocations, cached root checks to stop CPU stalls, and eliminated redundant reloads and listener leaks.
